# telnyx_portouts (Data Source)

The requests to port numbers away from Telnyx.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_carrier_name` (String) Filter by new carrier name.
- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter by 2-letter country code
- `filter_country_code_in` (List of String) Filter by a list of 2-letter country codes
- `filter_foc_date` (String) Filter by foc_date. Matches all portouts with the same date
- `filter_inserted_at_gte` (String) Filter by inserted_at date greater than or equal.
- `filter_inserted_at_lte` (String) Filter by inserted_at date less than or equal.
- `filter_phone_number` (String) Filter by a phone number on the portout. Matches all portouts with the phone number
- `filter_pon` (String) Filter by Port Order Number (PON).
- `filter_ported_out_at_gte` (String) Filter by ported_out_at date greater than or equal.
- `filter_ported_out_at_lte` (String) Filter by ported_out_at date less than or equal.
- `filter_spid` (String) Filter by new carrier spid.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter by portout status. One of `authorized`, `canceled`, `pending`, `ported`, `rejected`, `rejected-pending`.
- `filter_status_in` (List of String) Filter by a list of portout statuses
- `filter_support_key` (String) Filter by the portout's support_key
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `portouts` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portouts))

<a id="nestedatt--portouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `portouts`

Read-Only:

- `already_ported` (Boolean) Is true when the number is already ported
- `authorized_name` (String) Name of person authorizing the porting order
- `carrier_name` (String) Carrier the number will be ported out to
- `city` (String) City or municipality of billing address
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the portout was created
- `current_carrier` (String) The current carrier
- `end_user_name` (String) Person name or company name requesting the port
- `foc_date` (String) ISO 8601 formatted Date/Time of the FOC date
- `host_messaging` (Boolean) Indicates whether messaging services should be maintained with Telnyx after the port out completes
- `id` (String)
- `inserted_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the portout was created
- `lsr` (List of String) The Local Service Request
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Phone numbers associated with this portout
- `pon` (String) Port order number assigned by the carrier the number will be ported out to
- `reason` (String) The reason why the order is being rejected by the user. If the order is authorized, this field can be left null
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `rejection_code` (Number) The rejection code for one of the valid rejections to reject a port out order
- `requested_foc_date` (String) ISO 8601 formatted Date/Time of the user requested FOC date
- `service_address` (String) First line of billing address (street address)
- `spid` (String) New service provider spid
- `state` (String) State, province, or similar of billing address
- `status` (String) Status of portout request
- `support_key` (String, Sensitive) A key to reference this port out request when contacting Telnyx customer support
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the portout was last updated
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user (or organization) who requested the port out
- `vendor` (String) Telnyx partner providing network coverage
- `zip` (String) Postal Code of billing address
